question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Consent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dissent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Consent**: Permission for something to happen or agreement to do something. (अनुमति)
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options section.
 
 
• **Dissent**: A strong disagreement or dissatisfaction with a decision or opinion. (मतभेद)
 
• **Variety**: The quality or state of having different forms or types. (विविधता)
 
• **Integrity**: The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. (ईमानदार होने और मजबूत नैतिक सिद्धांत रखने का गुण; अखंडता)
 
• **Sanction**: Official permission or approval for an action. (किसी कार्रवाई के लिए आधिकारिक अनुमति या अनुमोदन)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Consent**' is '**Dissent**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
